mapper.sql: id, task_id, task_run_id, project_id, base_ref, head_ref, git_repository, diff_hash, file_count, addition_count, deletion_count, files_json, status, diff_content, diff_truncated, analysis_status, analysis_error, commit_sha, commit_message, committed_by, committed_at, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM review_snapshot WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM review_snapshot WHERE task_run_id = #{taskRunId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM review_snapshot WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status <> 'EXPIRED' ORDER BY id

SELECT id, snapshot_id, sequence_no, kind, risk_level, title, reason, decision_question, module_name, file_paths_json, key_hunks_json, requires_view, viewed_at, decision_status, decision_comment, decided_by, decided_at, created_at FROM review_change_unit WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} ORDER BY sequence_no, id

SELECT id, snapshot_id, change_unit_id, severity, status, title, description, impact, file_path, line_start, line_end, suggested_action, evidence_id, created_at, updated_at FROM review_finding WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, snapshot_id, change_unit_id, evidence_type, status, title, command_text, summary, source_type, source_id, occurred_at, created_at FROM review_evidence WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} ORDER BY occurred_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_snapshot ( task_id, task_run_id, project_id, base_ref, head_ref, git_repository, diff_hash, file_count, addition_count, deletion_count, files_json, status, diff_content, diff_truncated, analysis_status, analysis_error, commit_sha, commit_message, committed_by, committed_at, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{taskRunId}, #{projectId}, #{baseRef}, #{headRef}, #{gitRepository}, #{diffHash}, #{fileCount}, #{additionCount}, #{deletionCount}, CAST(#{filesJson} AS JSON), #{status}, #{diffContent}, #{diffTruncated}, #{analysisStatus}, #{analysisError}, #{commitSha}, #{commitMessage}, #{committedBy}, #{committedAt}, #{reviewedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE review_snapshot SET status = #{status}, analysis_status = #{analysisStatus}, analysis_error = #{analysisError}, files_json = CAST(#{filesJson} AS JSON), commit_sha = #{commitSha}, commit_message = #{commitMessage}, committed_by = #{committedBy}, committed_at = #{committedAt}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE review_change_unit SET viewed_at = #{viewedAt}, decision_status = #{decisionStatus}, decision_comment = #{decisionComment}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = #{decidedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
